events.title: The Cat Empire with Queensland Symphony Orchestra
events.description: Following the overwhelming response to its 2024 debut, The Cat Empire returns to Brisbane for a highly anticipated one-night-only encore performance with Queensland Symphony Orchestra.  This special concert sees the band re-imagining their catalogue on a grand orchestral scale – blending beloved Cat Empire classics with bold new arrangements written especially for this collaboration. Drawing on the band’s signature mix of Afro-Cuban, Seychellois Creole, Brazilian and flamenco...

events.title: 2026 Compose Program
events.description: The Compose Program is designed to introduce Queensland secondary school students to composing for orchestral instruments. Throughout the one year program, participants will engage in workshops and face-to-face activities under the guidance of QSO Composition Mentors Craig Allister Young, Timothy Tate, and Dr Lisa Cheney. Program participants will also have the opportunity to write compositions for the QSO Connect Ensemble, comprised of a selection of QSO musicians. This year, participants...

events.title: Maestro 7: Symphonic Dances
events.description: From folk steps to final farewells, this concert is built around the joy of dance. At its heart is Rachmaninov’s final major work Symphonic Dances. Written in exile, it is filled with sweeping emotion, nostalgia, and the echoes of a life in motion. Led by Chief Conductor Umberto Clerici, it’s a powerful blend of elegance and vitality complete with an unforgettable saxophone solo.   The evening begins with Dvořák’s Slavonic Dances, bursting with Bohemian spirit and irresistible folk...
